recipe.visualDefinition: A medium close-up portrait of a woman in a warm orange velvet blazer, set against a deep purple and blue sky filled with soft white clouds. The composition features a large, gestural monogram in the background and stylized typography with outer glows.
coreVisualRelationships: Warm orange subject contrasting against cool purple/blue background
Soft, diffused cloud textures mirroring the soft lighting on the subject's face
Large gestural monogram acting as a bridge between the subject and the background
Typography layered with outer glows to ensure legibility against complex textures
coreInvariants: Warm, directional lighting on the face

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject is positioned on the right third of the frame, angled inward, occupying approximately 60% of the vertical space.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and the bright orange shoulder of the blazer.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the subject's face, moves down the curve of the shoulder, then sweeps left across the title text and up to the monogram.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant negative space on the left side, filled with clouds and graphic elements.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Burnt Orange and Copper (Subject's clothing and hair)
colorSystem.accentColorRole: White and Pale Red (Typography glows and clouds)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the orange and purple tones; high value contrast between the white clouds and dark sky.

letterConstructionRules: Primary name uses a wide, low-waisted sans-serif with rounded terminals
Title text uses a fluid, brush-like script with varying line weights
Monogram uses a thin, continuous line weight with large loops
characterSpecificRedesigns: Script 'D' with a large open counter
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: A heavy, geometric sans-serif paired with a loose, organic script for a balance of modern and personal feel.

preserve: Outer glow on the script text

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the wide, tech-influenced 90s sans-serif look
Provides the casual, handwritten contrast for the title

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-resolution photo of a woman with copper-toned hair in an updo, wearing a burnt orange velvet blazer. She is looking down and to the side. The background is a dreamy, deep purple and blue sky with soft white clouds. Lighting should be warm and directional from the right.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large, thin-stroked purple monogram in the background. Place the artist name in a wide, white, lowercase sans-serif font across the center-left. Place the title in a white script font with a soft red outer glow in the lower-left quadrant.

verificationChecks: Is the orange blazer texture clearly velvet?
Does the sky have a purple-to-blue gradient?
Is the text legible against the cloud background?
Is the monogram thin and gestural?

adjustableVariables: Spread of the red outer glow on the script text
mustRedesign: Specific artist name and title wording
postGenerationChecks: Check for velvet sheen on the blazer
Ensure the hair has warm copper highlights
Verify the glow effect doesn't obscure the letterforms
Confirm the background clouds are soft-focus
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a warm-toned subject in rich fabric with a cool-toned, atmospheric sky background, then layer with wide sans-serif and glowing script typography.
